Pagination

Move between pages of results.

…

This preview responds to every theme axis — switch any axis in the Theme control (top right) to see hue, saturation, mode, tonal, contrast, density, type pairing, and direction applied live.

Content guidelines

  • Show first, last, and a window around current; disable edges.

Don't use for: Feeds and infinite lists where position does not matter — load more or infinite scroll fits better. Not for fewer than ~2 pages: hide it.

Design specs

  • Squares at --control-height-sm; current uses --accent-bg.

Code specs

  • .fds-pagination > .fds-page[aria-current]; <Pagination page total>.
/* CSS-first (any framework) */
<div class="fds-pagination">…</div>

/* React wrapper */
import { Pagination } from '@flavor-ds/ui';

Accessibility

  • <nav aria-label="Pagination">; prev/next have labels.
